annotations.text:
Moved off the website palette onto the client's own.

The greys are gone: panels are the warm olive stone the 2004 interface is built from, sampled out of your screenshot rather than guessed. Bevels are explicit now, light above-left and shadow below-right, which is what makes stone read as stone.

Panel titles are centred gold and actions sit along the bottom, the way Friends List does.

The rail is now a strip of interface tabs: stone tiles on the same dark ground the client uses, the open one lit and raised, the rest dimmed to 78%. Icons are flat sprites on a dark outline instead of thin outline strokes.
The game area stays pure black in these mockups. In the running app the client paints there, so nothing of ours is behind it.
